'Action - Destroy this: Each hero creates a Vigor token. Go again' -- ACTIVATE (action-speed equipment activation, offered by play._add_hero_dsl_activations) with the destroy as an ability COST, not an effect, so it can gate legality; cost shape copied from shipped wtr/barkbone_strapping and pen/boltn_boots. activation_cost 0 explicit (scabskin_leathers precedent): the only printed cost is destroying this.

'Each hero creates a Vigor token, including yourself' (release note): two CREATE_TOKEN effects, one SELF (the handler default) and one player OPPONENT -- the handler resolves OPPONENT to 3-cid, valid outside combat. Two-player modelling of 'all heroes left in the game'; json/tokens/vigor.json already exists.

GO AGAIN: authored as the GO_AGAIN effect type, which routes through _grant_go_again and handles the CR 8.3.5a/b split (equipment activation is a non-attack layer, so it pays its controller an action point directly). The PRINTED GoAgain keyword is inert here -- triggers/triggers.py build_keyword_triggers passes 'go again' through with no trigger, and has_go_again is only consulted for cards played onto the chain (engine.py resolution / actions.py), never for equipment activations -- so authoring the effect does not double-grant; _grant_go_again additionally guards CR 8.3.5c no-two-go-againss if a combat happens to be open.
